payload.title: messaging-service caches each caller's AI capabilities in Redis for 60 seconds with no eviction path, so a revoked role, permission or deactivated account keeps authorizing AI turns, and a newly granted one stays denied, until the entry expires
evidence: apps/messaging-service/src/ai/services/ai-caller-capabilities.service.ts:72 (a cached entry short-circuits the auth-service lookup, :72-80)
apps/messaging-service/src/ai/services/ai-caller-capabilities.service.ts:126 (the entry, including an empty denial, is written with the TTL; the ai:caller-caps key is referenced nowhere else)
apps/messaging-service/src/ai/services/ai-caller-capabilities.service.ts:21 (the header documents the one-minute staleness as the revocation bound)
apps/messaging-service/src/ai/services/ai-chat-bridge.service.ts:203 (the bridge authorizes every AI turn from this cache)
payload.rule_violated: Section 7 mandatory timing cell (after a revocation the messaging cache entry is evicted) and the repo hierarchy that prefers an automatic mechanism over documented staleness.
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-25, release R5.
